title: Sum to n
description:
Write `int sumTo(int n)` that adds up every whole number from 1 to `n`. `sumTo(4)` is 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10. For `n` below 1 the answer is 0.

This is the *accumulator* pattern: start a total at zero and add to it each time round the loop.
hints: Make `int total{ 0 };` before the loop, loop `i` from 1 up to and including `n`, and add `i` to `total` each time round. When `n` is below 1 the loop never runs, so the answer is the 0 you started with.
